answer.summary:
KAFKA-20623 implementation is complete and all tests pass. The topology description plugin has been successfully wired into GroupCoordinatorService with three main integration points:

1. **streamsGroupTopologyDescriptionUpdate()**: Handles topology push RPCs from clients, validates membership, calls plugin.setTopology(), and manages back-off on transient failures or persistence on success/permanent failures

2. **Heartbeat post-processing**: Sets TopologyDescriptionRequired flag when broker has a newer topology epoch than stored/failed epochs and no back-off is active, using per-group exponential backoff (30s-1h)

3. **DeleteGroups integration**: Calls plugin.deleteTopology() before tombstoning, returns GROUP_DELETION_FAILED on plugin failure

All 28 tests in GroupCoordinatorServiceTopologyDescriptionTest pass successfully with BUILD SUCCESSFUL result.
